channel.title: Microsoft SOC Brief
channel.description: Due within 7 days, new since the last brief, Microsoft changes in Graph and roles

item.title: [Due in 2 days] SSPR requires registered authentication methods
[Due in 2 days] Windows App adds three client-side wildcard domains for Windows 365
[Due in 7 days] EWS starts requiring a configured EWSAllowedAppIDs list, and Microsoft will generate one from 60 days of observed usage where none exists
item.description: Exchange Online · Due in 7 days · deadline 2026-10-10

item.title: [Due in 2 days] User-managed sync file exclusions and .db-wal default exclusion
item.description: M365 admin · Due in 2 days · deadline 2026-10-05

item.title: [Due in 7 days] EWS needs an EWSAllowedAppIDs allow list from 10 October; EWSEnabled=True alone stops being enough
item.description: Exchange Online · Due in 7 days · deadline 2026-10-10

item.title: [New] Exchange Server gets a V2 of the September security updates: CVE-2026-96940 lets a signed-in user read other people's mailboxes
[New] Security Operator loses default access to email threat policies and the Tenant Allow/Block List under Defender Unified RBAC, from early November
[New] Teams Rooms on Android, Teams phones and panels below the February 2026 app version lose their calendar as EWS is switched off from October
[New] The September 2026 Scan Cab was re-issued on 2 October to carry the new Exchange Server update; a copy downloaded earlier does not detect it
[New] Endpoint Privilege Management gains a third policy type: standard users can change IPv4, IPv6 and DNS settings without administrator rights
[New] Android corporate-owned work profile: Microsoft corrects the factory reset protection table, and a Settings reset is unprotected when FRP emails are not configured
[New] The Data Security AI Admin role is now described as editing Data Loss Prevention policies in general, no longer only those related to Copilot
[New] Purview brings sensitive information types, Exact Data Match, trainable classifiers and fingerprinting into one Classifiers experience: preview this month, GA in November
[New] Teams will warn when a meeting participant or organiser looks like an impersonation attempt (roadmap, November 2026)
[New] Teams will accept deepfake-detection signals from certified third-party providers in meetings (roadmap, November 2026)
[New] Dataverse records can be secured by the value of a column instead of by record ownership (public preview)
[Graph: Changed permission] EntraBackup.Read.All
item.description: DisplayText "Read Entra Backup configuration, preview jobs, and snapshots"; Allows the app to read the Entra Backup configuration, list snapshots and jobs, and enumerate the changes of a specific preview job. Endpoint added: GET /directory/recovery/configuration.

item.title: [Graph: New in service, not yet documented] ThreatHunting.ReadWrite.All
item.category: Graph: New in service, not yet documented
item.description: present in the Graph service principal as an application role and a delegated scope since the dump of 29 September 2026 — grantable; still absent from the permissions reference and from permissions.json

item.title: [Graph: Documented at Microsoft] Device.ProvisionForVDI
item.description: a published definition carrying display text, description, requiresAdminConsent true and privilegeLevel 3, with one path set - POST /devices/provision - and isHidden false in the deployment map
